low_threshold.description: Complexity score below which requests are routed to the cheap tier.

high_threshold.description: Complexity score above which requests are routed to the smart tier.

shadow_mode.description: If true, all requests are routed to the smart tier but savings are still calculated (monitor mode).

budget_limit_usd.description: Hard spend limit in USD. Once exceeded, all requests are forced to the cheap tier. 0.0 = unlimited.

tiers.description: Configuration for each routing tier (cheap, mid, smart).

TierConfig.description: Configuration for a single LLM tier.

base_url.description: Base URL of the LLM provider (e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1).

model.description: Model identifier to use for this tier.

api_key.description: API key for this provider. Supports env-var expansion (e.g. $OPENROUTER_API_KEY).

api_keys.description: List of API keys for round-robin load balancing across multiple keys.

cost_per_1k_tokens.description: Cost per 1k tokens for this tier, used for usage tracking.

max_context_tokens.description: Maximum context window size in tokens for this tier. Used for capacity-aware routing.
